filing.title: Summit Merger Sub SC TO-T tender offer for Alpine Data Systems Inc.
filing.bodyText:
SC TO-T
Subject Company: Alpine Data Systems Inc.
Offeror: Summit Merger Sub Inc.
Summit Merger Sub Inc. has commenced a third-party tender offer for all outstanding shares of Alpine Data Systems Inc. at an offer price of $18.50 per share net to the seller in cash, representing a 42% premium to Alpine's previous closing price. The board of directors recommends that stockholders tender their shares. The offer will expire at 11:59 p.m. New York City time on July 15, 2026, unless extended. The offer is subject to a minimum tender condition and regulatory approval and is not subject to a financing condition.
